segments.ja422:1.1: Dhammo have hato hanti, nāhato hanti kiñcanaṃ [kañcinaṃ (pī.)];
segments.ja422:1.3: Tasmā hi dhammaṃ na hane, mā tvaṃ [taṃ (syā. pī.)] dhammo hato hani.
segments.ja422:2.3: Pūtikañca mukhaṃ vāti, sakaṭṭhānā ca dhaṃsati;
segments.ja422:2.5: Yo jānaṃ pucchito pañhaṃ, aññathā naṃ viyākare.
segments.ja422:3.1: Sace hi saccaṃ bhaṇasi, hohi rāja yathā pure;
segments.ja422:3.3: Musā ce bhāsase rāja, bhūmiyaṃ tiṭṭha cetiya.
segments.ja422:4.1: Akāle vassatī tassa, kāle tassa na vassati;
segments.ja422:4.3: Yo jānaṃ pucchito pañhaṃ, aññathā naṃ viyākare.
segments.ja422:5.1: Sace hi saccaṃ bhaṇasi, hohi rāja yathā pure;
segments.ja422:5.3: Musā ce bhāsase rāja, bhūmiṃ pavisa cetiya.
segments.ja422:6.1: Jivhā tassa dvidhā hoti, uragasseva disampati;
segments.ja422:6.3: Yo jānaṃ pucchito pañhaṃ, aññathā naṃ viyākare.
segments.ja422:7.1: Sace hi saccaṃ bhaṇasi, hohi rāja yathā pure;
segments.ja422:7.3: Musā ce bhāsase rāja, bhiyyo pavisa cetiya.
segments.ja422:8.1: Jivhā tassa na bhavati, macchasseva disampati;
segments.ja422:8.3: Yo jānaṃ pucchito pañhaṃ, aññathā naṃ viyākare.
segments.ja422:9.1: Sace hi saccaṃ bhaṇasi, hohi rāja yathā pure;
segments.ja422:9.3: Musā ce bhāsase rāja, bhiyyo pavisa cetiya.
segments.ja422:10.1: Thiyova tassa jāyanti [thiyo tassa pajāyanti (ka.)], na pumā jāyare kule;
segments.ja422:10.3: Yo jānaṃ pucchito pañhaṃ, aññathā naṃ viyākare.
segments.ja422:11.1: Sace hi saccaṃ bhaṇasi, hohi rāja yathā pure;
segments.ja422:11.3: Musā ce bhāsase rāja, bhiyyo pavisa cetiya.
segments.ja422:12.1: Puttā tassa na bhavanti, pakkamanti disodisaṃ;
segments.ja422:12.3: Yo jānaṃ pucchito pañhaṃ, aññathā naṃ viyākare.
segments.ja422:13.1: Sace hi saccaṃ bhaṇasi, hohi rāja yathā pure;
segments.ja422:13.3: Musā ce bhāsase rāja, bhiyyo pavisa cetiya.
segments.ja422:14.1: Sa rājā isinā satto, antalikkhacaro pure;
segments.ja422:14.3: Pāvekkhi pathaviṃ cecco, hīnatto patva pariyāyaṃ [attapariyāyaṃ (sī. syā.), pattapariyāyaṃ (ka. sī. niyya)].
